payload.summary: The accounts for 2021/22, the pandemic year: a General Fund surplus of £2.384m, which the council states as 2.18% of its gross expenditure budget. Read the percentage with care — that year it is struck against a roughly £109m gross expenditure figure, where later years use a roughly £65m General Fund figure. Capital spending was £33.585m against £67.007m, half the programme.
